text.en: Two things done well, now at scale
text.th: Two things done well, now at scale

text.en: Grupo Boticário began in 1977 as a small compounding pharmacy in Paraná. According to Renato Pedigoni, the group’s CTO, the founder did two things very well: he served customers with care and affection, understanding their needs, and created high-quality products.
text.th: Grupo Boticário began in 1977 as a small compounding pharmacy in Paraná. According to Renato Pedigoni, the group’s CTO, the founder did two things very well: he served customers with care and affection, understanding their needs, and created high-quality products.

text.en: Almost five decades later, its ecosystem encompasses laboratories, factories, innovation, technology, logistics, marketing, and retail—with a presence in more than 40 countries, more than 4,000 physical stores across more than 1,700 Brazilian cities, and an ecosystem of 200,000 points of sale across retail, partners, and suppliers. It is one of Brazil’s largest beauty franchise networks.
text.th: Almost five decades later, its ecosystem encompasses laboratories, factories, innovation, technology, logistics, marketing, and retail—with a presence in more than 40 countries, more than 4,000 physical stores across more than 1,700 Brazilian cities, and an ecosystem of 200,000 points of sale across retail, partners, and suppliers. It is one of Brazil’s largest beauty franchise networks.

text.en: The company’s premise is that technology exists to keep doing those same two things—on a massive scale.
text.th: The company’s premise is that technology exists to keep doing those same two things—on a massive scale.

text.en: “Today, almost 50 years later, we use technology to continue doing those two things well, and at scale,” says Pedigoni.
text.th: “Today, almost 50 years later, we use technology to continue doing those two things well, and at scale,” says Pedigoni.

text.en: This is the origin of the term the company adopted to describe itself: Lovetech—the union of technology and human sensitivity as pillars of its culture, helping the company innovate while preserving the human touch.

text.en: Why the platform had to be proprietary
text.th: Why the platform had to be proprietary

text.en: The decision to develop solutions internally stems from how the group operates: a vertically integrated chain that runs from research and development laboratories through manufacturing, distribution, and logistics to the final interaction with customers.
text.th: The decision to develop solutions internally stems from how the group operates: a vertically integrated chain that runs from research and development laboratories through manufacturing, distribution, and logistics to the final interaction with customers.

text.en: That interaction happens on many fronts at once. Beyond being multi-brand, the group is multichannel: physical stores, e-commerce, marketplaces, franchising, direct sales, B2B, and B2P. More than 10 consumer brands—including O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse Berenice, Vult, and Truss—operate under different business models, with franchisees, resellers, and beauty professionals in salons.

text.en: “Once we have this complexity of multiple brands, categories, and channels, we can build our own technology that brings it all together,” Pedigoni explains.
text.th: “Once we have this complexity of multiple brands, categories, and channels, we can build our own technology that brings it all together,” Pedigoni explains.

text.en: The return is twofold: better listening to customers at the point of contact and optimization of the production chain—which inputs to buy, where to distribute them, to which store, and how many units of each SKU need to be delivered.

text.en: Grupo Boticário was not born digital. But it has reached a stage where it develops critical solutions and processes internally—supported by the premise of digital democratization: making data accessible across the company for analyses, AI models, and dashboards. For the fifth consecutive year, the company was recognized among Latin America’s most admired companies in data, ranking second in State of Data Brazil 2025–2026, by Data Hackers in partnership with Bain & Company.

text.en: An agent platform for the entire reseller journey
text.th: An agent platform for the entire reseller journey

text.en: OpenAI provides the technology in the group’s proprietary agent orchestration platform, which combines foundation models with business rules to democratize the creation of agents focused on activating and serving its key partners: resellers and franchisees.
text.th: OpenAI provides the technology in the group’s proprietary agent orchestration platform, which combines foundation models with business rules to democratize the creation of agents focused on activating and serving its key partners: resellers and franchisees.

text.en: “Today we have hundreds of agents in our ecosystem serving customers, partners, franchisees, and resellers,” says Pedigoni.
text.th: “Today we have hundreds of agents in our ecosystem serving customers, partners, franchisees, and resellers,” says Pedigoni.

text.en: The reseller journey alone has more than 30 agents, covering everything from registration and the first order to day-to-day operational support—alongside agents dedicated to validating the content and effectiveness of responses, ensuring continuous improvement of the solution. The architecture combines generative and predictive AI.
text.th: The reseller journey alone has more than 30 agents, covering everything from registration and the first order to day-to-day operational support—alongside agents dedicated to validating the content and effectiveness of responses, ensuring continuous improvement of the solution. The architecture combines generative and predictive AI.

text.en: The journey is divided into two areas.
text.th: The journey is divided into two areas.

text.en: For reseller onboarding, AI qualifies leads: a lead arrives through a digital channel and is received by AI to clarify questions about joining. When the lead signals an intention to complete an order, it is transferred to human support. This ensures a prompt first response, with service available 24 hours a day, and directs leads ready to advance through the journey to the human team. The solution covers 90% of leads captured in direct sales.
text.th: For reseller onboarding, AI qualifies leads: a lead arrives through a digital channel and is received by AI to clarify questions about joining. When the lead signals an intention to complete an order, it is transferred to human support. This ensures a prompt first response, with service available 24 hours a day, and directs leads ready to advance through the journey to the human team. The solution covers 90% of leads captured in direct sales.

text.en: For reseller support, agents autonomously resolve day-to-day operational requests: sending catalogs, answering questions about payment slips, handling app questions, and addressing general topics. Since November 2025, they have covered 100% of conversations generated in appchat and WhatsApp Enterprise, with up to 80% autonomous resolution.

text.en: “OpenAI helps us enormously by delivering foundation models at scale, so we can focus on our business rules and what our resellers need,” says Pedigoni.

text.en: He is careful to shift the interpretation of these figures.
text.th: He is careful to shift the interpretation of these figures.

text.en: “Sometimes we think of automation as something closely tied to efficiency. We prefer to see this automation as improving the quality of our service and enabling our supervisors to have an even deeper relationship with consumers and resellers, too.”

text.en: Repetitive work is removed from the sales force’s routine, allowing it to focus on better understanding resellers, their context, and their customers. On the other side, resellers receive quick answers and gain time to act as advisors within their own businesses.

text.en: The people serving customers write the prompts
text.th: The people serving customers write the prompts

text.en: One of the operation’s distinguishing features is organizational rather than technical: the business team manages prompts on the platform.
text.th: One of the operation’s distinguishing features is organizational rather than technical: the business team manages prompts on the platform.

text.en: It was not always this way. When the first agents were built years ago, prompts were the technology team’s responsibility—a more technical task in unfamiliar territory. Results were good, but the group saw value in continuous iteration: optimizing prompts every day and running A/B tests between approaches.

Results were good, but the group saw value in continuous iteration: optimizing prompts every day and running A/B tests between approaches.

text.en: “And there is no one better to do that than the team serving customers today,” Pedigoni says.
text.th: “And there is no one better to do that than the team serving customers today,” Pedigoni says.

text.en: The change altered the teams’ roles. Sales, customer service, and support teams began managing their own prompts, with continuous incremental improvements based on feedback from daily use. They expanded their focus beyond direct work with resellers to include service systems and models—drawing on their own frontline experience.
